name: Trolley
description: Payouts platform for companies that pay recipients globally, with tax, compliance and fraud tools.
notes: Founded as Payment Rails, rebranded Trolley. Toronto office listed first on its site, but BetaKit says most staff are in Montreal; HQ not explicitly stated on company site.
address: 1 University Ave, 3rd Floor, Toronto, ON M5J 2P1

name: Wattpad
description: Storytelling platform where writers and readers discover and share stories.
notes: Acquired by Naver in 2021 (now part of WEBTOON Entertainment); remains headquartered in Toronto. Founded year 2006 from general knowledge, not re-verified in this pass.

name: Private AI
description: Software that detects, redacts and replaces PII in text, documents, images and audio (now branded Limina).
notes: private-ai.com now redirects to getlimina.ai (product renamed Limina); careers page had no open roles listed. Series A led by BDC Capital.

name: smartARM
description: Develops an AI-vision prosthetic arm that recognizes objects and adjusts its grip automatically.
notes: Founding year 2018/2019 depending on source. Site says 'Designed in Toronto'; a 2020 profile listed Oshawa but recent sources (Meta, Sept 2026) say Toronto-based. No careers page.

name: SnapWrite AI
description: AI merchandising platform that structures product data and publishes it to ecommerce sales channels.
notes: snapwrite.ca redirects to snapwrite.ai. Founded 2022 per Globe and Mail (PitchBook says 2020). Funding mostly grants and competitions.
address: 175 Bloor St E, Suite 1080, Toronto, ON

name: Toothpod
description: Functional dental chewing gum for oral care when brushing is not possible, spun out of the University of Toronto.
notes: toothpod.ca redirects to toothpod.co. Founded 2022 per U of T (PitchBook says 2020). Reported ~USD/CAD 850K raised plus grants; unclear round names, stage is an estimate.

name: zeroone.ai inc.
description: Develops an AI information-processing and model management platform, with offices in Toronto and Seoul.
notes: Site mentions a first Toronto office and a Seoul office; CB Insights lists 175 Bloor St E, Toronto, but no company-site address, so address left null. Founded 2018 per CB Insights; NextAI 2018 cohort via SAFE. Sector changed from Fintech (site and CB Insights show AI/medical data). Seed stage is an estimate.

name: zofiQ
description: Toronto agentic AI startup building AI agents that automate IT service desk work inside PSA platforms.
notes: Acquired by ConnectWise in January 2026 (terms undisclosed); zofiq.ai now redirects to ConnectWise.
